from pathlib import Path
p = Path("tests/test_generate.py")
src = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old_header = """from lumen_sdk import LumenAPIError, LumenRateLimited

from pixforge.billing import get_balance
from pixforge.features.generate import generate_image
from pixforge.images import list_images
"""
new_header = """from datetime import datetime, timezone

from lumen_sdk import LumenAPIError, LumenRateLimited

from pixforge import clock, quota
from pixforge.billing import get_balance
from pixforge.features.generate import generate_image
from pixforge.images import list_images
"""
assert src.startswith(old_header)
src = new_header + src[len(old_header):]
src = src.rstrip("\n") + '''


def test_free_daily_image_limit(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    sixth = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-6")
    assert not sixth["ok"]
    assert sixth["error_code"] == "daily_image_limit"
    assert sixth["job_id"] is None
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 5
    assert get_balance(conn, user_id) == 90


def test_daily_image_limit_message_names_the_limit(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    en = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-6", locale="en")
    ru = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-7", locale="ru")
    assert en["message"] == "You have reached today's free plan limit of 5 images."
    assert ru["message"] == "Вы исчерпали дневной лимит бесплатного тарифа: 5 изображений."


def test_pro_is_not_limited_by_daily_images(conn, lumen, pro_user_id):
    for i in range(8):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, pro_user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 8


def test_retry_does_not_use_up_daily_image_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")
    for _ in range(10):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 1


def test_daily_image_quota_resets_on_next_utc_day(conn, lumen, user_id):
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 1, 23, 59, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    for i in range(5):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-5")["ok"]

    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 2, 0, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-6")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image", "2026-03-02") == 1


def test_provider_error_releases_daily_image_slot(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.fail_with = LumenAPIError(500, "internal", "boom")
    generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_filtered_result_releases_daily_image_slot(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.filter_next = True
    generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_insufficient_credits_releases_daily_image_slot(conn, lumen):
    from pixforge.users import create_user

    poor = create_user(conn, "poor@example.com", balance=1)
    generate_image(conn, lumen, poor, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, poor, "image") == 0
'''
p.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")
EOF
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30
